title: Review of lab 1's flow-lenia fl_morph257 (I): fresh seeds 5 and 6 give 7-10 discrete ring-shaped individuals of two channel kinds that persist at bounded size to t=400; little motion and reticulate splitting
summary: First labkit pack of threads/flow-lenia/worlds/fl_morph257/world.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (128^2, 200 frames, t=400). From the planted noise patch (t=0), A0 (orange) and A1 (cyan) rings, crescents and dumbbells separate by t~100 and then sit as 7-10 discrete bodies to t=400 (pack/seed5/sheet.png); persistent-track area ratio 1.73; A1 scores membrane-like (ring-shaped bodies). Seed 5: 57 splits, 50 merges, 1 persistent split; 3 tracks move >= 1 body length (max 2.1). Seed 6: 3 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.93, 11 moving tracks.

observations.I: pack/seed5/sheet.png t=150-400: 7-10 discrete bodies (A0 rings, A1 rings and crescents) at bounded size; seed 6 the same

verdicts.limitation: Planted noise patch, not full-domain noise, so S does not apply; bodies are nearly static by t~200 and splits are mostly re-merging fragments (merge/split 0.88-0.93), so nothing beyond I is supported here.
